label: has athlete on team
definition: Team or sporting organization X has or had person Y as a player or competing athlete.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit player or athlete on X; X fields or plays Y as an athlete; a stated playing membership in X. Excludes: coach or manager alone; wanting or needing Y without roster membership; an opponent rather than a team member; ordinary possession or a book title. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic have without athlete-role context; proposed recruitment without established membership; unclear team or player identity. Inverse of athlete_for. A team needing a person does not prove that the person plays for it.

facts.reason: Knicks → Patrick Ewing: The Knicks explicitly play Patrick Ewing, with team-lead and possession context supporting his athletic membership.
